id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parsableDiagrams.description: The collection of {@link ParsableDiagram}s associated with this collection.

workflowRun.description: The DS {@link Workflow.Run} triggered on the {@link #parsableDiagrams} in this collection.

userDismissed.description:
Flag indicating whether user has dismissed a card notification corresponding to this `UploadedParsableDiagramCollection ` in the UI.
Used to handle hiding of card notifications from `ParsingJobsSidePanelCardList`, but still run the parsing job in background.
This flag is set to `true` when user dismisses a notification in the UI through {@link DismissParsingJobEpic}.

numFiles.description: The number of {@link SourceParsableDiagram}s being tracked

parsingStatus.description: The current status of the parsing job, populated by {@link #getParsingStatus}
enum: Step 1 of 2: Extract symbols and text from P&IDs
Step 2 of 2: Match Parsed Text to Sensor IDs

title:
This type represents a collection of {@link ParsableDiagram}s for which a parsing job is triggered.
An entity of this type is created upon starting the parsing job for the {@link ParsableDiagram}s.
name: UploadedParsableDiagramCollection
